name: Create a skill eval case, then compare the seeded v1 and v2 skill runs on the per-skill dashboard
description: SPEC-08 AC-37, no model call. Opens the seeded skill 'pr-quality-rubric' in the Skills Lab, switches to its Evals tab (3 seeded cases) and creates + saves one more case with '+ New eval case'. Then /eval -> Skills tab lists the skill, opens its per-skill dashboard (/eval/skills/<id>), selects the two seeded completed runs (v1 fails 2/3, v2 passes all; different skill text, same provider/model) and opens Compare: both versions in the title, the metric deltas and the skill-text diff (a line only in v1 and a line only in v2). Promote is not offered because v2 is already the skill's current version. The 'run -> edit text -> save -> run' segment of AC-37 is covered by server/test/skill-eval-runs.it.test.ts and the client flow tests with a mocked fetch (it needs a model call). Requires migration 0021 and the seed in server/src/db/seed-eval.ts. Creates one skill-owned case; everything else is read-only seeded data. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (e2e-web.yml); run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
